text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"About the race we're running today... Are 
there any girls Maya hasn't met before?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...I see, then I might actually look 
forward to it a little.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Plus, Trainer-chan, this is the race you 
chose just for Maya, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
In this race, I'm sure... without a doubt. 
...I'll really be able to feel the thrill.
